title: Committed review-form-stepper-f1 artifacts record the pre-fix r0 state with no resolution markers
evidence:
diff.txt embedded r0 exports: `+  var api = {
+    EVENT_STEP_CHANGED: EVENT_STEP_CHANGED,
+    GATING_MESSAGE: GATING_MESSAGE,
+    REVIEW_HINT_STEPPER: REVIEW_HINT_STEPPER,` (no shouldActivate/stepChangeDetail/resolveAnchorTarget the shipped module exports) — blind-hunter.md: `1. **Blocker — `.gitignore:31` — `form_stepper.js` is git-ignored; the feature never ships.**` while the same commit adds `+!server/priv/static/form_stepper.js` — spec-form-stepper-f1.md:7: `review_loop_iteration: 0`
detail: Committing review records fits the tracked implementation-artifacts convention, but this folder freezes the pre-fix diff and unresolved findings (including a 'blocker' whose fix ships in the same commit) with no resolution status, misrepresenting what actually shipped to future readers.
recommended_fix: Add a resolution header to blind-hunter.md/edge-hunter.md (fixed/deferred per finding, as deferred-work.md already records one), bump review_loop_iteration, or regenerate diff.txt at the merged sha.
